#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Purge old Cloudflare Pages deployments.
# Usage:
#   ./purge-deployments.sh              # delete old deployments
#   ./purge-deployments.sh --dry-run    # preview only
#
# Reads CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, and
# KEEP_DEPLOYMENTS (default: 5) from .env in the same directory.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
if [[ -f "$SCRIPT_DIR/.env" ]]; then
  set -a
  source "$SCRIPT_DIR/.env"
  set +a
fi

ACCOUNT_ID="${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:?Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID in .env}"
API_TOKEN="${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?Set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in .env}"
KEEP="${KEEP_DEPLOYMENTS:-5}"
PROJECT="murphys-autocare"
DRY_RUN=false
[[ "${1:-}" == "--dry-run" ]] && DRY_RUN=true

API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/$ACCOUNT_ID/pages/projects/$PROJECT/deployments"

echo ""
echo "==> Cloudflare Pages: $PROJECT"
echo "==> Keeping $KEEP most recent deployments"
$DRY_RUN && echo "==> DRY RUN — nothing will be deleted"
echo ""

# Fetch all deployment IDs with pagination
ALL_IDS=""
page=1
while true; do
  response=$(curl -s "$API?page=$page&per_page=25" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN")

  ids=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.result[].id')
  total_pages=$(echo "$response" | jq -r '.result_info.total_pages')

  if [[ -n "$ids" ]]; then
    ALL_IDS="${ALL_IDS}${ALL_IDS:+$'\n'}${ids}"
  fi

  if [[ "$page" -ge "$total_pages" ]]; then
    break
  fi
  page=$((page + 1))
done

# Sort newest first (the API already returns newest first per page,
# but we fetched multiple pages so re-sort via the full list)
# Actually the IDs alone can't be sorted by date, so we just rely on
# the API's default sort order (newest first) across pages.

TOTAL=$(echo "$ALL_IDS" | grep -c . || true)
echo "Found $TOTAL deployments"

if [[ "$TOTAL" -le "$KEEP" ]]; then
  echo "Nothing to purge."
  exit 0
fi

# Split into keep/delete
DELETE_IDS=$(echo "$ALL_IDS" | tail -n +$((KEEP + 1)))
DELETE_COUNT=$(echo "$DELETE_IDS" | grep -c . || true)

echo "Deleting $DELETE_COUNT old deployments..."
echo ""

deleted=0
errors=0

for id in $DELETE_IDS; do
  if $DRY_RUN; then
    echo "  would delete $id"
    deleted=$((deleted + 1))
  else
    if curl -s -X DELETE "$API/$id?force=true" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" | jq -e '.success' > /dev/null 2>&1; then
      echo "  deleted $id"
      deleted=$((deleted + 1))
      sleep 0.25
    else
      echo "  FAILED  $id"
      errors=$((errors + 1))
    fi
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "Done: $deleted deleted, $errors errors, $KEEP kept"
